name: Being A Women Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that being a woman of God involves a heart aligned with His will, as seen in the desire for God to grant according to one’s heart and counsel (Psalms 20:4) and the petition to be taught to do His will (Psalms 143:10). Such a woman recognizes her God-given worth and praises Him for His marvelous creation of her (Psalms 139:14). Wisdom is demonstrated in building and nurturing her household (Proverbs 14:1), extending compassion to the poor and needy (Proverbs 31:20), and earning the respect and blessing of her family (Proverbs 31:28). These verses collectively portray a woman who is spiritually grounded, wise, compassionate, and honored within her home.
